title: Spider bite leads Fox to one of the girls

tellings.quote: incident." He goes, "Oh my gosh, I dated one of the girls."

plain: In 2012, in Varginha, Brazil, a spider bite led the filmmaker James Fox to someone close to one of the girls in the town's famous alien case, where an army is said to have caught a live creature. Fox tells Michels that a man he met because of the bite said, "Oh my gosh, I dated one of the girls." The chance meeting gave him a way to reach a witness.
